high_level_description: This image is a highly detailed and imaginative digital artwork that depicts a grand, classical-style building with multiple levels, set against a dramatic night sky. The building features large columns, statues, and intricate architectural details, reminiscent of neoclassical or baroque styles. The structure appears to be partially submerged in a cave or underground, creating a surreal and fantastical scene. The top level of the building is illuminated by artificial lighting, casting a warm glow on the facade and highlighting its architectural features.
